info.name: Jito Block Engine JSON-RPC Bundles Transactions API

params.name: bundleOnly
params.description: When true, the transaction is treated as a single-transaction bundle.

items.docs: JSON-RPC 2.0 endpoint exposing the `sendTransaction` method. Acts as a direct proxy to Solana's `sendTransaction`, but routes the transaction through the Block Engine to the next leader for inclusion. Optional `bundleOnly=true` query parameter forces the transaction to be wrapped in a single-tx bundle so it is processed under bundle semantics.
